message.subject: PH-100 – two-year commitment and revised pricing
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

We value our twelve-year partnership and want a sustainable agreement for your foundry. The wage movement you describe does not yet explain the full requested increase; please share the remaining cost drivers, your current full manufacturing cost per housing, and your annual financing rate so we can understand the pressure properly.

In return for a 24-month commitment at 4,000 housings per year, please consider these alternatives, each effective 1 April 2027:
A: EUR 48.60 per housing, payment 30 days net, contract 24 months.
B: EUR 49.20 per housing, payment 45 days net, contract 24 months.
C: EUR 49.80 per housing, payment 60 days net, contract 24 months.
The existing price would remain until the agreed effective date; FCA and 35-day lead time remain unchanged.

Our preference is A, combining prompt payment with dependable work over two years. Which package best supports your planning, and what adjustment would you need to make it workable?

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Compared three complete asks with immediate acceptance. Anchor around current price with two-year volume and early-payment tradeoffs; obtain supplier cost evidence before assessing relationship charge. Revise if supplier rejects extension or identifies a sustainable cost floor.

trace.final_text: Sent three two-year proposals and requested the foundry’s cost breakdown.

message.subject: SH-220: counterproposal for 24-month award
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,

Thank you for the prompt quote. The competing offer offer:DEMO-C1-0 is EUR 16.00 per shaft, so we need a more competitive package for the award.

For 6,000 shafts per year over 24 months, please consider either:
A: EUR 13.40 per unit, 14 days net, 35 days lead time, DAP; or
B: EUR 13.00 per unit, 30 days net, 28 days lead time, EXW.

Option A brings faster payment and more scheduling room. Which package fits your shop better, and would predictable call-offs help you improve it?

Best regards,
Purchasing | Hollerau Pumpenwerke

message.subject: SH-220: delivery requirement and counterproposal
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your proposal. We are considering an award of 6,000 shafts per year for 24 months. Our production requires a 35-day lead time; please confirm you can support this reliably.

We propose EUR 12.80 per unit, 60 days net, 35 days lead time, DAP. Alternatively, for faster payment: EUR 13.40 per unit, 14 days net, 35 days lead time, DAP.

Please identify which option is more attractive and any delivery or freight constraint preventing acceptance.

Best regards,
Purchasing | Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Both opening acceptance and fallback are inferior to pursuing counters; C1 opening also fails lead-time mandate. Test cash/scheduling preferences at J1 and delivery/freight constraints at C1, preserving scope for a concession next round. Predictions remain weak role-based evidence.

trace.final_text: Counteroffers sent to both suppliers with alternative payment packages and clear delivery requirements.

message.subject: PH-100 – revised alternatives and basis of our proposal
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for accepting the two-year horizon and offering an April start. To answer your question: my comment was based only on the wage movement and cost share in your opening email, not on a separate external index claim. Our proposals are commercial counteroffers; I cannot substantiate an independent should-cost figure for this housing.

I respect the confidentiality of your cost structure. An aggregate full cost per housing or a sustainable price range, without individual cost details, would help us avoid an agreement that undermines supply. Please include the promised overview of scrap, wages and gas and explain which payment arrangement is most valuable to you.

We can improve our proposals as follows, all for 24 months and effective 1 April 2027:
A: EUR 49.00 per housing, payment 30 days net.
B: EUR 49.50 per housing, payment 45 days net.
C: EUR 50.00 per housing, payment 60 days net.
The annual commitment remains 4,000 housings; FCA and the 35-day lead time are unchanged. The existing price remains until the effective date.

Please review A in particular: prompt payment and two years of dependable work are our contribution toward closing the remaining price gap.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Supplier moved materially more than nearest record, mainly by structure. Compare continued negotiation to accepting 422426.30; three modestly improved packages forecast further movement. No applicable recorded cost data exists, so request aggregate sustainable range and do not cite unavailable IDs.

trace.final_text: Sent improved proposals and clarified the basis of our pricing request.

message.subject: SH-220: revised cash-payment package
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,

Thank you for the movement and for explaining your capacity and cash needs. We can work with 35 days rather than pay for overtime, and retain the 14-day payment you prefer.

I am increasing our DAP proposal to EUR 13.50 per shaft, 14 days net, 35 days lead time, DAP, for 6,000 units annually over 24 months. We are willing to coordinate predictable call-offs with your production planning.

Please complete your internal price review on this package. If transport is the obstacle, please explain the freight allowance separately so we can settle the right structure.

Best regards,
Purchasing | Hollerau Pumpenwerke

message.subject: SH-220: management review of revised proposal
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for confirming reliable delivery within 35 days. We will accommodate your preference for 14-day payment and raise our DAP proposal to EUR 13.50 per unit, 14 days net, 35 days lead time, DAP.

The competing offer offer:DEMO-J1-1 is EUR 15.10 per unit on EXW terms, so your current EXW price is not competitive.

As an alternative, we propose EUR 13.10 per unit, 14 days net, 35 days lead time, EXW. Please seek management approval for these packages for 6,000 shafts annually over 24 months; no overtime or shorter delivery is required.

Best regards,
Purchasing | Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: J1 cash preference and internal review support small price concession rather than abandoning deep ask; larger concession loses leverage. C1 is tracking slow gap-share behavior, so retain deep ask while moving on cash and price and supply verified rival evidence. Both standing acceptance and walk-away are materially worse than continued negotiation.

trace.final_text: Revised offers sent, prioritizing 14-day payment and seeking further price approval.

message.subject: PH-100 – further movement on the 30-day package
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for confirming that 30-day payment is most useful to your foundry. We will keep that as our preferred route and respect your decision not to disclose full costs.

We can move again to these alternatives, each for a 24-month contract effective 1 April 2027:
A: EUR 49.30 per housing, payment 30 days net.
B: EUR 49.60 per housing, payment 45 days net.
C: EUR 50.10 per housing, payment 60 days net.
Our commitment remains 4,000 housings annually, with FCA and 35-day lead time unchanged; the existing price remains until 1 April.

Please make your best sustainable move on A, reflecting the prompt payment and two-year commitment. If your workable price is higher, please return the 30-day April package as your formal offer rather than only as an alternative in the email. We want to settle on a package that both sides can maintain.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Further modest concession while preserving optimized duration/date and supplier-preferred payment. Expected improvement to roughly 417356 beats accepting 420424; supplier's unbindable 30-day alternative also cheaper. A holding reply would indicate approaching limit. Cost disclosure refused; no grounded full-cost estimate available.

trace.final_text: Sent a further revised proposal, prioritising the foundry’s preferred 30-day payment terms.

message.subject: SH-220: further revision for approval
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for obtaining approval. We recognize that bar material and machining wages drive your calculation, but the remaining commercial gap is substantial.

We can increase to EUR 13.60 per shaft, 14 days net, 35 days lead time, DAP; alternatively EUR 13.20 per shaft, 14 days net, 35 days lead time, EXW. Both apply to the 24-month award with 6,000 shafts annually.

Please review the best achievable price with management, using the fast payment and regular annual volume. Is the difference primarily material or machining time, and is there a more efficient production lot size we can coordinate within the 35-day lead time?

Best regards,
Purchasing | Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: J1 response pending; do not close prematurely. C1 has closed only 5% then 7% of ask gap, rival verified but ineffective. Retain deep anchor with small concession and question about actual production levers rather than large price concession; larger 14.50 ask would shrink its likely remaining step.

trace.final_text: Sent a modestly revised counteroffer to Demo Machining while awaiting Demo Drehteile’s price review.

message.subject: PH-100 – one package for final review
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for the further reduction. Let us now focus exclusively on the 30-day arrangement that best supports your planning.

We raise our proposal to EUR 49.50 per housing, payment 30 days net, contract 24 months, effective 1 April 2027. The existing price remains until then. The annual commitment is 4,000 housings, with FCA and the 35-day lead time unchanged.

Please review this package personally for your best sustainable price. Your reply describes the 30-day arrangement as primary but still lists the 60-day arrangement as the formal offer; please issue your formal revised offer with 30-day payment, the April start and the two-year term, so we can conclude on that basis.

We appreciate the steps you have taken and want this agreement to support continued dependable cooperation.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Compared single focused ask at 49.50 to conciliatory 50.50 and acceptance. Deeper modestly improved ask forecasts 415966 vs 417325 and keeps supplier's preferred terms. Narrow to one sheet to secure formal primary 30-day structure before probable final offer.

trace.final_text: Sent a focused 30-day-payment proposal and requested a matching formal offer.

message.subject: SH-220: volume plan and revised proposal
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,

Thank you for sharing the breakdown and completing the review. The planning reference is fc:SH-220@2026-09. Our price-review reference is cost:part:SH-220.

The award covers 6,000 shafts per year for 24 months. To reserve machine time, I propose 500 shafts each month in months 1–24, with call-offs issued at least 35 days ahead; please confirm this schedule suits your machines.

I can raise our offer to EUR 13.60 per shaft, 14 days net, 35 days lead time, DAP. This retains fast payment and avoids overtime. Please review the remaining reduction against the capacity you have available and the regular production schedule.

Best regards,
Purchasing | Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Answer supplier's explicit figures request with looked-up case-listed IDs without invented values; supply proposed monthly schedule based on fixed annual volume and its spreadsheet. Small concession retains gap leverage; direct cost 12.76 leaves overhead uncertain. Larger 14.00 candidate reduces expected remaining step; acceptance now premature.

trace.final_text: Sent the requested data references, proposed monthly call-offs, and a revised cash-payment offer.

message.subject: SH-220: evidence of gap and final review request
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

The evidence you requested is offer:DEMO-J1-2: EUR 15.20 per shaft, 14 days net, 35 days lead time, DAP. This is below your EXW price and includes transport.

We can now offer EUR 13.70 per shaft, 14 days net, 35 days lead time, DAP; alternatively EUR 13.30 per shaft, 14 days net, 35 days lead time, EXW, for the 24-month award of 6,000 shafts annually. Please obtain your best approved package for comparison.

We cannot approve a different material grade or wider tolerances without engineering approval, so please retain the existing specification. Thank you for explaining the production options.

Best regards,
Purchasing | Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: C1 likely final next reply and has moved slowly; supply new verified rival DAP sheet on its request and a small concession. Do not authorize drawing changes. Higher price/60-day candidate unlikely attractive given stated cash preference. J1 pending, so acceptance now would forego its reductions.

trace.final_text: Sent verified competing terms and requested Demo Machining’s best approved package without specification changes.

message.subject: PH-100 – closing proposal
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for issuing the formal 30-day offer. We recognise your emphasis on sustainable supply and appreciate the improvement from your opening proposal.

To make one further contribution toward agreement, we can raise our price to EUR 50.00 per housing, payment 30 days net, contract 24 months, effective 1 April 2027. The existing price remains until that date; 4,000 housings annually, FCA and 35-day lead time remain unchanged.

If you can meet this package, we are ready to conclude it. If EUR 51.20 is indeed your firm limit on the same terms, please confirm that as your final offer and we will take the closing decision without another round of price requests.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Terms already optimal given supplier's 0.50 premium for 60 days exceeds buyer benefit. Compare acceptance418460 to asks50.00 and50.80, tool predicts better outcome for50.00. Latest held price outweighs optimistic prediction; one last meaningful concession while agreeing to stop if limit reaffirmed. No substantiated cost estimate supplied.

trace.final_text: Sent a closing proposal and requested confirmation if the supplier’s price is firm.

message.subject: SH-220: full award volume and next price step
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,

Thank you; we appreciate the further reduction. We can commit the full award requirement of 6,000 shafts annually for 24 months to the selected supplier, but cannot promise additional demand beyond this. Our proposed schedule remains 500 shafts monthly with 35 days' notice.

I can move to EUR 13.70 per unit, 14 days net, 35 days lead time, DAP. We are keeping the cash-friendly payment and regular machine loading you requested. Please see how close you can come on that basis, without overtime or specification changes.

Best regards,
Purchasing | Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Thread has twice closed 19% of gap, contrary to early fixed-step analogies. Small concession yields better predicted outcome than 14.00 and preserves a further move if final. DAP better than EXW structure at evaluated ask; cannot invent higher annual volume outside mandate.

trace.final_text: Confirmed the full award volume and sent a further modest price revision to Demo Drehteile.

message.subject: SH-220: acknowledgment of final offer
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for confirming your final offer of EUR 15.40 per shaft, 14 days net, 35 days lead time, EXW. We have recorded it for the award comparison. It remains above the competitive package available to us, so we cannot accept it at this stage.

We appreciate the management review and your confirmation that the existing specification will be maintained.

Best regards,
Purchasing | Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: C1 final is materially dearer than J1 standing, and post-final analogies show negligible agreement probability. Acknowledge without wasting concessions; preserve pending J1 negotiation rather than accepting or closing whole case.

trace.final_text: Acknowledged Demo Machining’s final offer; Demo Drehteile’s revised offer remains pending.
Accepted €50.70 per housing, 30-day payment, and a 24-month contract effective 1 April 2027.
Accepted Demo Drehteile’s offer: €14.70 per shaft, DAP, 14-day payment, and 35-day lead time.
